description: See what the user sees: ask to watch their camera or screen on one of their paired devices, then get still pictures of it, returned as images you can look at (and saved, default ./inbox/watch). The first call asks; their device shows your reason and they share the camera or the screen there, or decline. Later calls return new stills from the same share, so you can guide them step by step ("now turn the switch on the left"). It ends when they stop, when you call watch_stop, or after 5 minutes without a call; their device ends it after 15 minutes.

count.description: Stills to take now, 1 to 5. Default 1.

device.description: Name of a paired device (from list_devices). Optional when only one is paired.

folder.description: Where to save the stills: a relative path inside the server's folder, with no folder starting with a dot. Default: inbox/watch.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between those stills, 0.5 to 10. Default 1.

purpose.description: Needed when not watching yet: what you want to see and why, in one or two sentences the user reads on their device (at most 300 characters).

wait_seconds.description: When asking: how long to wait for the user to share, 120 by default, at most 600.

name: watch_frames
